source_details: At first lying down under malignant Saturn OR Mercury, the source says they are commonly heavy and describes heaviness, drowsiness, unwilling movement of diseased members, stupor or numbness with excessive cold, or molested with unnatural defluxions. rules.title: Historical medicine polarity — What Medicines are agreeable to the nature of Mars

source_locator.section: Hermes Trismegistus upon the first Decumbiture of the Sick
source_locator.passage_anchor: What Medicines are agreeable to the nature of Mars

rules.source_attribution: Hermes-headed material in Lilly 1647; authorial interpolations uncollated
rules.source_statement: The printed PDF306 describes what medicine classes are agreeable to Mars versus Saturn; the Mars-to-Saturn sentence literally contains 'not calefactive' and remains semantically ambiguous. The following line assigns Saturn refrigerating/cooling, astringent/binding and repercussive medicines, said contrary to Mars; subsequent paragraphs assign organs and fever classes to planetary influences.
prerequisites: Historical humoral attribution.
exceptions_and_modifiers: Potential internal inconsistency around attribution of organ diseases to Sun/Mars versus Saturn/Mercury must not be silently corrected.
PDF306 prints 'not calefactive' in the first polarity statement. Do not silently emend to 'hot' or infer an executable polarity; ambiguous intended meaning remains unresolved.
source_details: The original PDF306 visibly prints that medicines agreeable to Mars are repugnant to Saturn 'as not calefactive, emollient, or mollifying and dissolving obstructions'. Retain 'not' literally; its position is hard to reconcile with the immediately adjacent assignment of heating medicines to Mars, and the intended parsing or printing error remains UNRESOLVED.
Infirmities, passions and trembling of the heart, those from the mouth of the stomach, and pains of arteries, veins and joints are attributed to evil Mars and Sun influence.

Continued fevers, phrensies, exulceration and inflammation of lungs/lights are then attributed to Saturn and Mercury, with refrigerating medicines called most proper. This explicit target-and-remedy statement differs from the heating/softening recommendation for Saturn/Mercury origins on PDF307 (R1675). Preserve the local tension; do not silently swap planets or a remedy polarity.

rules.title: Saturn catalogue — Aries

rules.source_statement: Under the inherited Saturn/Moon conditions, Aries is associated with head/eye/ear complaints, catarrhal symptoms, disturbed sweating and drowsiness; a subsequent dire death claim depends on absence of good planetary support.
prerequisites: Moon in Aries
Moon decreasing in light and motion (catalogue introduction)
Moon afflicted by Saturn by conjunction, square or opposition at illness onset/question.

source_details: Inherited Saturn-catalogue conditions plus Moon in Aries. Symptoms: headache or head heaviness; rheum in nostrils; singing ears; stuffing in the head; weary/dull eyes; rheum and corrupt humours descending into throat and windpipe; weak, inordinate pulses; drowsy mind; stomach loathing; intemperate/unseasonable sweats; heat within and cold without; worse by night than day.

If the Moon receives no favourable aspect of a good planet, the source asserts death without doubt, God sending no extraordinary remedy. Both lack of assistance and the extraordinary-remedy clause remain explicit.
Loosening the belly is described as relieving the grief, while letting blood is called ill in this row. These local historical prescriptions are not clinical instructions.

rules.source_statement: Taurus is associated with chest, heart, liver, lung and vascular complaints after alleged overindulgence. The text gives a fourteen-day danger statement without fortune support, but allows unexpected recovery under a good lunar aspect.
prerequisites: Moon in Taurus
Moon decreasing in light and motion (catalogue introduction)

source_details: Inherited Saturn-catalogue conditions plus Moon in Taurus. Fevers proceed from obstructions/distemper of the praecordiacks and arteries, glossed as inward parts near heart, liver and lungs; excess, surfeits or repletion are alleged causes. High/lofty but immoderate pulses, bodily puffing and lung ulceration are described.

Without gentle fortunate aspects to the Moon the party will hardly live fourteen days; under a good aspect the sick may recover beyond expectation. The latter is possibility, not certainty. Purging/dissolving gross humours and phlebotomy are described as good in this row.

rules.source_attribution: printed Hermes section in Lilly; first-person interpolations not independently assigned to ancient author
rules.source_statement: Gemini is linked with mental overburdening, travel or exertion, dispersed bodily and joint pain, sweats and consumption; a ten-day mortal claim adds Mars jointly afflicting the Moon, and a Jupiter/Venus intervention is stated as an escape condition.
prerequisites: Moon in Gemini
Moon decreasing in light and motion (catalogue introduction)
Moon afflicted by Saturn by conjunction, square or opposition at illness onset/question.
exceptions_and_modifiers: Do not score the ten-day claim for Saturn alone: concurrent Mars is specified.
Benefic intervention changes the asserted outcome.
The author also describes this sign more generally; testimonies are dependent.
source_details: Inherited Saturn-catalogue conditions plus Moon in Gemini. Alleged causes: mental weariness and overburden from many affairs, travel, excessive bodily exercise. Small-fever fear and pain dispersed through the body, especially arteries/joints.
The first-person passage says 'I ever find' the vitals much afflicted, tendency to consumption, rare/little pulse, frequent sweat, spleen symptoms, and worse illness at night.

If Mars TOGETHER WITH Saturn afflicts the Moon at the same time, most authors are reported to hold that the sick will not live above ten days, UNLESS a favourable Jupiter OR Venus aspect intervenes; then after a long time the sick MAY recover. This is attributed testimony, not a counted patient series.
rules.source_details_scope: All descriptions and prescriptions are historical source assertions, not endorsed medical facts or patient instructions.

rules.title: Saturn catalogue — Cancer

source_locator.section: Hermes Trismegistus upon the first Decumbiture of the Sick
source_locator.passage_anchor: tough melancholly Matter, or with slimy, thick Flegme

rules.source_attribution: printed Hermes section in Lilly; first-person interpolations not independently assigned to ancient author
rules.source_statement: Cancer is associated with breast/phlegm/respiratory and fever complaints. Decreasing Moon near Saturn body is linked to long duration; a further clause adds ascendant-lord impediment by the eighth lord to lunar affliction for small hopes of recovery.
prerequisites: Moon in Cancer
Moon decreasing in light and motion (catalogue introduction)
Moon afflicted by Saturn by conjunction, square or opposition at illness onset/question.
exceptions_and_modifiers: Keep the proximity-duration clause separate from the further ascendant/eighth-ruler impediment clause; their compact connection is not a licensed universal Boolean formula.
Cross-page continuation PDF308–309 is one row.
source_details: Inherited Saturn-catalogue conditions plus Moon in Cancer. Breast affected by tough melancholy matter or slimy thick phlegm; coughs, abundant spittle/moisture, catarrhs, hoarseness, rheum descending into breast, narrow obstructed pipes, many times, small fevers, fear of quotidian but usually a long quartan ague; belly ache or infirmity in reins/secrets.

If the Moon is decreasing and near Saturn body, the sickness continues a great space of time. In a further clause, if together with lunar affliction the ascendant lord is impeded by the eighth lord, there are small hopes of recovery. The proximity-duration and additional ruler-impediment clauses are distinct; do not turn small hopes into certain death.
rules.source_details_scope: All descriptions and prescriptions are historical source assertions, not endorsed medical facts or patient instructions.

rules.title: Saturn catalogue — Leo

source_locator.section: Hermes Trismegistus upon the first Decumbiture of the Sick

rules.source_attribution: printed Hermes section in Lilly; first-person interpolations not independently assigned to ancient author
rules.source_statement: Leo is linked with feverish chest and heart complaints, faintness and possible black jaundice. The text conditions death near the Moon-Saturn opposition on lack of specified assisting aspects.
prerequisites: Moon in Leo
Moon decreasing in light and motion (catalogue introduction)
Moon afflicted by Saturn by conjunction, square or opposition at illness onset/question.
exceptions_and_modifiers: Fortune aspects (Jupiter/Venus) can change the adverse prognosis.
A suggested gentle heating/moistening remedy is historical.
source_details: Inherited Saturn-catalogue conditions plus Moon in Leo. Melancholy blood, unkindly breast heat, strained heartstrings, violent fevers/troubled pulse, harmful inner/outer heat, sometimes stone, heart faintness or swooning. Black jaundice is a danger IF the illness continues long.

The source proposes gentle moistening/heating. When the Moon reaches opposition to Saturn, if Jupiter OR Venus does not assist by sextile, trine OR conjunction, the sick dies many times. The frequency phrase and specified assisting aspects are retained.
rules.source_details_scope: All descriptions and prescriptions are historical source assertions, not endorsed medical facts or patient instructions.

rules.title: Saturn catalogue — Virgo

rules.source_attribution: printed Hermes section in Lilly; first-person interpolations not independently assigned to ancient author

prerequisites: Moon in Virgo
Moon decreasing in light and motion (catalogue introduction)
Moon afflicted by Saturn by conjunction, square or opposition at illness onset/question.
exceptions_and_modifiers: First-person experiences are anecdotal and unquantified.
No independent case count or follow-up.
The original Virgo phrase 'things which mollifie heat and dissolve' might read as three verbs (mollify, heat, dissolve) or mollify [temper] heat; document both, do not normalize its therapy polarity.
source_details: Inherited Saturn-catalogue conditions plus Moon in Virgo. Crudities/ill digestion in stomach, viscous phlegm obstructing bowels/intrails, shooting/pricking under ribs and inordinate fevers.

First-person additions: wind-colic and many-times recurrent suffering, extreme melancholy, gout or aches in thighs/feet. Mollifying, heating and dissolving things are called proper. The author seldom finds such illness anything but long, giving earthy Virgo and slow Saturn as rationale; not a measured duration or independent causal demonstration.
rules.source_details_scope: All descriptions and prescriptions are historical source assertions, not endorsed medical facts or patient instructions.

Moon afflicted by Saturn by conjunction, square or opposition at illness onset/question.

First-person continuation across PDF309–310: great pains in joints, knees and thighs, with itch in those parts and fear of sciatica. These observations share the same row, not separate patients.

Moon decreasing in light and motion (catalogue introduction)
Moon afflicted by Saturn by conjunction, square or opposition at illness onset/question.

source_details: Inherited Saturn-catalogue conditions plus Moon in Scorpio. Anal ulcer, haemorrhoids/piles, exulceration, bubo or a botch in private members are described.

The first-person enquiry passage explicitly reads no retention of Urine; also bladder stone, swelling dropsical humour around knees/legs, sometimes flux (the source's 'sometimes'), with 'usually' elsewhere in the same row; for a man gonorrhea, for a woman too much abundance of menstrual discharge. No retention must not be normalized to retention. Modern diagnosis or urinary subtype is not inferred.
rules.source_details_scope: All descriptions and prescriptions are historical source assertions, not endorsed medical facts or patient instructions.

source_quote_exact.purpose: polarity preservation; not a modern diagnostic interpretation

rules.title: Saturn catalogue — Sagittarius

source_locator.section: Hermes Trismegistus upon the first Decumbiture of the Sick
source_locator.passage_anchor: Deflux of subtill, thin, sharp Humours

rules.source_attribution: printed Hermes section in Lilly; first-person interpolations not independently assigned to ancient author
rules.source_statement: Sagittarius is linked to thin defluxions, joint/artery pain, fever and temperature swings. A separate Mars co-affliction is said to heighten the condition to violent burning fever.
prerequisites: Moon in Sagittarius
Moon decreasing in light and motion (catalogue introduction)
Moon afflicted by Saturn by conjunction, square or opposition at illness onset/question.
exceptions_and_modifiers: An additional Mars aspect is required for the intensified fever condition.
Experience paragraphs in the source do not identify patients.
source_details: Inherited Saturn-catalogue conditions plus Moon in Sagittarius. Thin/sharp defluxions, arteries/joints pain, fear of fever, extremes of heat/cold and often double fever access. Gently mitigating heat and moistening is the local historical prescription.

First-person conjunction with Saturn: infected choleric/melancholy blood, many times excessive pains-taking or violent exercise followed by cold. Opposition to Saturn: for the most part gout or tumour/swelling in hands, thighs or feet.
Mars ALSO casting an ill aspect to the Moon, as well as Saturn, at first falling sick is required for the subsequent violent burning-fever assertion.
rules.source_details_scope: All descriptions and prescriptions are historical source assertions, not endorsed medical facts or patient instructions.

Moon decreasing in light and motion (catalogue introduction)
Moon afflicted by Saturn by conjunction, square or opposition at illness onset/question.

The physical left-ear condition crosses page 310–311.
source_details: Inherited Saturn-catalogue conditions plus Moon in Capricorn. Cold/melancholy, thin subtle distillations, heaviness of breast/stomach, difficult breathing, dry cough, oppressed lungs, intended (intensified) fevers, more pain at night. Moderate heating/moistening is the source remedy.
The first-person continuation across PDF310–311 adds that the sick is still complaining of headache, pain in the LEFT ear, or rumbling/noise in the head.

rules.source_attribution: printed Hermes section in Lilly; first-person interpolations not independently assigned to ancient author
rules.source_statement: Aquarius is associated with labor, sleep deprivation and changing illness. The sick is said to be recoverable if the Moon passes opposition to its original longitude and benefic planets cast good aspects.
prerequisites: Moon in Aquarius
Moon decreasing in light and motion (catalogue introduction)
Moon afflicted by Saturn by conjunction, square or opposition at illness onset/question.
exceptions_and_modifiers: The exact combination of lunar transit plus benefic aspect matters.
No synthetic date or severity estimate.
source_details: Inherited Saturn-catalogue conditions plus Moon in Aquarius. Too much labour/toil of body and mind, lack of sleep and due refreshment are alleged origins. Illness is uneven, remitting and intensifying, until the Moon passes opposition to HER OWN INITIAL PLACE; if fortunes then have a good aspect to her, the sick is recoverable.

First-person additions: wind or noise in the head; faint fits/passions of heart; often sore throat or a rising there and danger of suffocation. No fixed day count is supplied for the geometrical event.
rules.source_details_scope: All descriptions and prescriptions are historical source assertions, not endorsed medical facts or patient instructions.

First-person additions: excess cold, throat oppressed with thick phlegm, breast troubled by rotten cough and watery matter. Heating and gently calisfying medicines are described as good; no temperature, dose or modern drug is supplied.

Moon placed in sign and afflicted by different planet group
exceptions_and_modifiers: Do not silently treat every planet as the same operative afflictor.
source_details: The transition describes the completed twelve-sign material as Moon oppressed by Saturn, or indeed Mercury, and announces the next twelve-sign descriptions for lunar affliction by Mars OR Sun. rules.title: Mars catalogue — Aries

source_locator.section: Hermes Trismegistus upon the first Decumbiture of the Sick
source_locator.passage_anchor: The disease shall proceed from a distempered affection of the Membranes

rules.source_attribution: printed Hermes section in Lilly, with first-person observational additions of uncertain author
rules.source_statement: Aries is linked with fever, brain or membrane distress, thirst, liver heat and potential sensory disturbance. Another adverse prognosis requires a separating Moon then Saturn contact during waning and slow lunar motion.
prerequisites: Moon in Aries
Moon afflicted by Mars conjunction, square or opposition at first illness onset (the printed catalogue formulation).
exceptions_and_modifiers: After separation from Mars the NEXT application must be Saturn conjunction OR opposition, with decreasing light AND slow motion, for the small-hopes statement.
Small hopes is not a certain-death conclusion.
Historical cooling/bloodletting remarks are not endorsed.
source_details: Moon in Aries afflicted by Mars conjunction, square OR opposition at first illness. Membranes/pellices of brain affected, continued fever, unrest, hot thirsty mouth, extreme thirst, dry tongue, hot/inflamed liver, breast heat, high/sublated irregular pulse; phrensy or deprivation of senses may be feared. Bloodletting and cooling/nourishing are described as helpful.

If NEXT after separation from Mars evil beams/aspect, the Moon also applies to Saturn conjunction OR opposition while DECREASING in light and SLOW in motion, there are small hopes of life and religious preparation is urged. This is not any Saturn contact or an unconditional death result.
First-person addition: usually near madness, or extreme belly/small-gut pain from choleric obstructions.
rules.source_details_scope: All descriptions and prescriptions are historical source assertions, not endorsed medical facts or patient instructions.

Moon afflicted by Mars conjunction, square or opposition at first illness onset (the printed catalogue formulation).
exceptions_and_modifiers: A first-person paragraph reports stone/strangury anecdotes without a denominator.
Do not translate symptoms into proven modern causes.
source_details: Moon in Taurus afflicted by Mars conjunction/square/opposition at onset. Excess ill blood, continual fever, whole-body obstruction, throat/neck/hind-neck inflammation, bone ache, unkind slumbers without sleep, desire for wine/cold water. Bloodletting and moderately cooling/allaying heat are described as necessary.
First-person additions: strangury, stone/gravel in reins/kidneys, pestilent sore throats, hoarseness or malignity in that member.
rules.source_details_scope: All descriptions and prescriptions are historical source assertions, not endorsed medical facts or patient instructions.

prerequisites: Moon in Gemini
Moon afflicted by Mars conjunction, square or opposition at first illness onset (the printed catalogue formulation).
exceptions_and_modifiers: No numeric chance of death stated for this row.
Do not pool symptom variants as distinct cases.
source_details: Moon in Gemini afflicted by Mars at taking bed, with marginal conjunction/square/opposition. Usually violent dangerous fever, obstructions, high/inordinate pulse, overly hot/rank blood and body near corruption; the author says 'a necessity there is of emission of blood' historically.

First-person additions: pain throughout body with no settled location, extremely windy/corrupted blood, lameness or grief in arms/joints, stone or heat in reins, and sometimes spitting blood. Exhaustion is not independently asserted in this row.

The historical emetic therapy mentioned is not a recommended intervention.
source_details: Moon in Cancer afflicted by Mars: abundant sweet phlegm in stomach, too much ingurgitation or surfeit, frequent vomiting or wish to vomit, with turning/eversion of the ventricle.

The first-person continuation calls it usually a mere surfeit from riot/excess and says most people the writer has seen thus afflicted were cured by vomiting. It many times turns to looseness or a rotten filthy cough, sometimes with spitting blood. The cure assertion has no number of patients or independently verified endpoint.

Moon afflicted by Mars conjunction, square or opposition at first illness onset (the printed catalogue formulation).
exceptions_and_modifiers: Ninth-day claim is conditional on other heavenly configurations.
No dated patient endpoint.
source_details: Moon in Leo afflicted by Mars: excessive blood/strong fevers, very weak pulses, raving/raging fits, disturbed brain, poor appetite, heaviness/drowsiness, heart disorders and consumption danger.
The source says USUALLY death ABOUT THE NINTH DAY AFTER FIRST FALLING SICK, IF OTHER HEAVENLY CONFIGURATIONS ACCORD. Usual, approximate, time origin and corroboration restriction are retained.

The author particularly fears Moon-Mars CONJUNCTION OR OPPOSITION in this sign more than elsewhere; this comparison must not be generalized to every aspect.

Moon afflicted by Mars conjunction, square or opposition at first illness onset (the printed catalogue formulation).
exceptions_and_modifiers: No benefic assistance is part of the thirty-day adverse rule.
Original narrative says not easily removed but not universally fatal.
source_details: Usually, Moon in Virgo afflicted by Mars: belly alteration/flux or miseriacks, small fevers, choler/melancholy, remiss pulse, ventricle eversion and food loathing. Death WITHIN THIRTY DAYS is asserted IF FORTUNES DO NOT ASSIST.

Moon afflicted by Mars conjunction, square or opposition at first illness onset (the printed catalogue formulation).

Continuing lines on PDF314 belong to the same entry.
source_details: Moon in Libra afflicted by Mars: plenitude of blood, intense fevers, high pulse, sleeplessness/no natural rest and whole-body inflammation.

rules.title: Mars catalogue — Scorpio

source_locator.section: Hermes Trismegistus upon the first Decumbiture of the Sick
source_locator.passage_anchor: grievous infirmness in his or her privy parts

rules.source_attribution: printed Hermes section in Lilly, with first-person observational additions of uncertain author
rules.source_statement: Scorpio is associated with genital/anal disease and a highly speculative claim about sexually transmitted affliction or marital wrongdoing.
prerequisites: Moon in Scorpio
Moon afflicted by Mars conjunction, square or opposition at first illness onset (the printed catalogue formulation).
The source also discusses a QUERENT propounding a question, including distinct modifiers for a modest querent, a man asking, and the converse.
exceptions_and_modifiers: Unsupported moral inference or spouse culpability must not be promoted into a factual psychological or clinical claim.
First-person sexual diagnoses and treatment suggestions lack case identification.
source_details: Moon in Scorpio afflicted by Mars: neither better nor worse, but grievous private-part infirmity; usually ulceration, small or French pox, measles if children, haemorrhoids/piles.

First-person Scorpio passage adds head snuffling, grievous colds/rheums, scabs and skin eruptions. It makes unsupported appearance-based diagnoses of French pox, gonorrhoea or a burning after saying 'if the party looke like a wanton'. In a separate question context, if a MODEST party enquires the author suspects foul play; if a MAN propounds the question he insinuates the WIFE may be at fault; 'in Contrario' allows the converse case. These are misogynistic/sexualized source accusations, never evidence about any actual person.

The row calls the condition corrupt blood, calls heating/comfort now necessary, and calls it usually scandalous. Its local heating prescription must not be replaced by the broad Mars-cooling recommendation.
rules.source_details_scope: All descriptions and prescriptions are historical source assertions, not endorsed medical facts or patient instructions.

rules.title: Mars catalogue — Sagittarius

source_locator.section: Hermes Trismegistus upon the first Decumbiture of the Sick
source_locator.passage_anchor: surfeiting or gluttony, or too much repletion

rules.source_attribution: printed Hermes section in Lilly, with first-person observational additions of uncertain author
rules.source_statement: Sagittarius is associated with fever, heat and bowel distress. The source attaches possible recovery to surviving a specified critical Moon square, without exact independent outcome data.
prerequisites: Moon in Sagittarius
Moon afflicted by Mars conjunction, square or opposition at first illness onset (the printed catalogue formulation).
exceptions_and_modifiers: Keep critical-day timing distinct from a literal seventh-day onset or guaranteed recovery.
The claimed lunar square is to the Moon's initial position.
source_details: Moon in Sagittarius afflicted by Mars: desperate illness attributed to surfeit/gluttony/repletion, high fevers, choleric passions, flux/laske and few/faint or slow/weak pulses.

If the sick escapes the SEVENTH DAY, or more properly the day when the Moon comes to a TRUE SQUARE OF HER FIRST-LYING-DOWN PLACE, there are hopes of recovery. Seven days and the geometrical event are not automatically identical, nor is either a guaranteed cure.

First-person additions: daily found overheated blood after excessive exercise, extreme burning, sometimes pestilent fever with bloodletting twice/thrice, hand/foot gout, itch/eruptions, sore throat or sharp rheum offending eyes.
rules.source_details_scope: All descriptions and prescriptions are historical source assertions, not endorsed medical facts or patient instructions.

prerequisites: Moon in Capricorn
Moon afflicted by Mars conjunction, square or opposition at first illness onset (the printed catalogue formulation).
exceptions_and_modifiers: Continuation on PDF315.
No unique case count, prognosis probability, or safe remedy supplied.
source_details: Moon in Capricorn afflicted by Mars: no perfect concoction, abundant choler, desire to vomit, absent appetite, sinew swelling/puffing, immediate belly flux, continual/returning fevers, breast inflammation, ulceration or choleric humour in hands/joints/fingers; remiss slow pulse. Obstructive/constringent medicines are called useful.

rules.source_details_scope: All descriptions and prescriptions are historical source assertions, not endorsed medical facts or patient instructions.

rules.title: Mars catalogue — Aquarius

source_locator.section: Hermes Trismegistus upon the first Decumbiture of the Sick
source_locator.passage_anchor: slow in motion, and decreasing in light

rules.source_attribution: printed Hermes section in Lilly, with first-person observational additions of uncertain author
rules.source_statement: Aquarius is associated with violent sharp affections or vehement passions as alleged causes, in a context requiring a slow waning Moon and Mars affliction; a separate good-aspect intervention by any favourable planet at first square or opposition to the initial Moon is said to bring relief after twenty days.
prerequisites: Moon in Aquarius

source_details: At onset Moon in Aquarius, SLOW in motion AND DECREASING in light, afflicted by Mars. Sharp/violent affections or vehement passions are alleged origins.

Any favourable planet casting its GOOD ASPECT to the Moon at her FIRST SQUARE TO HER OWN INITIAL PLACE OR at opposition to that initial zodiacal degree is said to give present remedy after TWENTY DAYS. Both the transit condition and the literal time phrase remain; this text alone does not reconcile their chronology or compute a cure date.
First-person additions, especially under opposition: heart pain, swooning, desperate fever, blood swelling veins, high pulses, sometimes breast pain and difficult breathing.
